text: 央行公开市场操作节奏微调，3 个月买断式逆回购转为等量续作 本周逆回购到期规模高达22275亿元，最终实现14115亿元大额净回笼。
text_en: PBOC Adjusts Open Market Operation Pace Slightly, 3-Month Outright Reverse Repo Switched to Equivalent Rollover; Weekly Reverse Repo Maturities Total 2,222.5 Billion Yuan, Resulting in Net Withdrawal of 1,411.5 Billion Yuan
